research_status: 2014-2020 outcome-blind semantic freeze followed by Development; 2021-2023 remains unopened for this exact contract until the Development gate is resolved
economic_hypothesis: In a PIT-observable sector bull, an already orderly long-cycle leader that forms a tight, lower-turnover high base has reduced immediately available supply. A completed close through the prior five-session pressure level on expanding turnover is evidence of renewed demand. The trade begins only at a later legal open.
independence: No collapse-gap, true-gap, gap-repair, or below-gap event identity is used.

binding_conditions.PIT_SECTOR_BULL_WITH_MARKET_GUARD: industry_n>=5; industry median ret20>8%; industry positive-ret20 share>65%; industry median ret60>10%; industry positive-ret60 share>60%; industry-minus-market ret20>5%; market median ret20>-5%; market positive-ret20 share>35%; market median ret60>-8%; market positive-ret60 share>35%; market median ret120>-12%; market positive-ret120 share>30%
binding_conditions.ORDERLY_ESTABLISHED_LEADER: signal-close ret120>0; prior-completed-60-session return>10%; prior60 net-return / sum(abs(daily returns))>=8%; prior60 high/low range<=35%; prior close no more than 18% below prior60 high
binding_conditions.SUPPLY_EXHAUSTION_BASE: prior-completed-10-session high/low range<=18%; prior5 mean turnover / prior6-20 mean turnover<1.05
binding_conditions.RENEWED_DEMAND_TRIGGER: completed signal close>=prior completed 5-session high; signal return in [1.5%,8.5%]; close location>65%; signal turnover / prior20 mean turnover>1.10

feature_clock: completed signal-session close; all rolling stock windows exclude the signal session except ret120 and the trigger bar itself; market and industry cross-sections use only the completed signal session
entry: first legal daily open strictly after the signal, within three exchange sessions

failure_exits.X1: after T+1, two consecutive completed exchange sessions close below the frozen prior5 breakout level; sell next legal open
failure_exits.X2: after T+1, completed close below frozen prior10 platform floor; sell next legal open
